SparkR / SPARKR-142
Function dependencies are captured too late, so that the value of free variables have already changed

Change By: hao
The function dependencies is computed when JRDD is constructed. However, this should be done when PipelinedRDD is created. Otherwise, there is possibility that the values of free variables have already changed.

E.g. 
rdd <- parallelize(...)
free.var <- 1
rdd1 <- lapply(rdd, function(x) { x + free.var } )
free.var <- 2
rdd2 <- lapply(rdd, function(x) { x + free.var} )
collect(rdd1)
collect(rdd2)

The result is wrong since both rdd1 and rdd2 will have free.var == 2, since free.var is updated before rdd1 is evaluated.

Suggested Solution: Maybe we can add a "depsBin" in the PipelinedRDD object, and compute the dependencies once the PipelinedRDD is created.

Re: Function dependencies are captured too late, so that the value of free variables have already changed

hao This is a good point and this behavior could be unintuitive to users. I think your proposal of having a depsBin per RDD is along the right lines – However I think this change is a bit tricky as in worker.R we'll need to load the right env for each RDD we evaluate (we only load one depsBin globally at the beginning right now).

FWIW I think the behavior is broken in Scala too (I just checked a similar code path to what you posted) and there have been efforts to fix this in https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/SPARK-729 but they haven't been merged.

Re: Function dependencies are captured too late, so that the value of free variables have already changed

One approach that I used in the past is to make deep copies of environments to prevent side effects. Didn't make it recursive though, the efficiency implications were bad. So in this examples you have two anon functions sharing the global.env, you can make a copy of it for each of the functions so that no side effects are possible anymore. So you wouldn't need to do anything more complicated in the worker.

Re: Function dependencies are captured too late, so that the value of free variables have already changed

It is fixed by https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/pull/186, and no need for extra changes. I save the closure with each function and use nested functions in the pipeline as before.

However, if you could remember, an alternative way is using a accumulator to store functions. One of the benefits of that might be that we could support "..." in lapply, by storing the ... argument in each element of the accumulator. That would be a nice feature, but a minor issue.
